candidate_headline: Evolutionary memory is hierarchical rather than scale-optimal.

promotion_rule.if_ruellia_pass: Candidate may be considered for promotion after full format/reference/submission audit.
promotion_rule.if_ruellia_fail: Do not claim cross-representation prospective generalization; revise candidate around retrospective hierarchical architecture only.
promotion_rule.if_ruellia_hold: Keep v0.7 as non-current candidate and retain v0.3 as current submission.

novelty_ceiling: Generalize isolated within-phenotype pathway signal into a cross-radiation architecture in which fine identity often retains additional historical organization after coarse membership is fixed, distinct from overall memory amplitude and the globally best resolution.
prohibited: first evidence that pigment pathways have phylogenetic signal
first recognition that state aggregation changes phylogenetic information
universal hierarchical-memory law before prospective Ruellia outcome
